data.title: Three years on, Israeli rescuer cannot escape October 7
data.description: JERUSALEM - Israeli rescuer Natan Kenig says it does not take much of a trigger for him to relive the October 7, 2023 attack: his eyes open or closed, at home or out with friends, he still sees the rockets, torched cars and lifeless bodies.

data.title: How Piyasombatkul is Pivoting from Plywood to Prime Bangkok Property
data.description: The Piyasombatkul family’s potential acquisition of nearly 20 rai of prime Wireless Road freehold land signals a major shift into commercial property development

data.title: EU, China to hold Beijing talks to avert trade war
data.description: BRUSSELS - EU trade chief Maros Sefcovic will head to Beijing on Thursday for two days of make-or-break meetings with Chinese officials to try to stave off a trade war.

data.title: New deal for Nan, Luang Prabang
data.description: NAN: Nan and Luang Prabang have signed an agreement to strengthen cooperation in trade, investment, cultural heritage and tourism.

data.title: Research into weight-loss drugs tipped for Nobel as award week opens
data.description: STOCKHOLM - Research into hormones that regulate appetite is on everybody's lips for the Nobel medicine prize, to be announced on Monday when the 2026 Nobel season kicks off.

data.title: Rubio visits Iceland as US boosts Arctic presence
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - US Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel Monday to Iceland to continue pressing US interests in the Arctic, two weeks after Washington sealed a security pact on Greenland.

data.title: Thai Textile Society hosts shibori summit
data.description: Thai Textile Society is holding the next Collector's Corner talk on "Unfolding Shibori: Techniques, Traditions, And Mastery", at Siam Society, Asok Road, on Saturday at 10am.

data.title: 'ALaLa Dance Fest 2026' is coming to Chiang Mai
data.description: 'Spirit & Ritual" is the theme for "ALaLa Dance Fest 2026", which brings contemporary artists to perform and conduct workshops, at Kalm Village in Chiang Mai from Saturday to Oct 13.

data.title: Thailand advances 10-year plan for five health hubs to become a global medical and wellness centre and drive economic growth
data.description: Thailand’s medical and wellness plan spans treatment, products, research and events, with a 10 billion baht clinical research investment target.

data.description: Developer expects THB 10bn in net gains from 48.4bn baht asset injection into AWR REIT, as management seeks to balance lower debt with investor returns

data.title: Not 1997 Again: Thai Banks' Bad Loans Are a Chronic Wound That Is Hard to Clear
data.description: Fitch expects bad loans to stay at 3% to 4% as clearing stalls, debt buyers retreat and banks pay dividends instead of lending to riskier borrowers

data.title: Mahiru returns to Bangkok with 'One-Man Asia Tour Auralisia'
data.description: Japanese singer-songwriter Mahiru is set to return to Bangkok with her "One-Man Asia Tour Auralisia" on Dec 12. Presented by Live Nation Tero, the concert will take place at Lido Connect Hall 3, Rama I Road, and the tickets will be available from Oct 15.

data.title: Portugal move into Nations League knockout stage, Germany held
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Portugal became the first team to reach the quarter-finals of the Nations League when they beat Norway 2-1 on Sunday, but Jurgen Klopp's Germany were frustrated by Greece.

data.title: Chadchart rules out any severe flooding repeats
data.description: Flooding in the capital was gradually easing, with the city shifting its focus to recovery and draining the remaining water, Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt said, ruling out a repeat of last week's severe flooding.

data.title: Compensation claims top 850k
data.description: The government is speeding up flood relief, with more than 850,000 people registered for compensation across 65 provinces and all 50 Bangkok districts.

data.title: Timor-Leste PM  to visit this week
data.description: Timor-Leste Prime Minister Kay Rala "Xanana" Gusmão will visit Thailand on Oct 9-10 for talks with Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on bilateral cooperation, security and trade.

data.title: Atchariya slams betting ring charges
data.description: Activist Atchariya Ruangrattanapong has denied all charges after police traced more than 40 million baht between his accounts and an online boxing betting network.

data.title: Panel calls MP Suchada and husband
data.description: People's Party (PP) MP Rangsiman Rome has called Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband to testify before a House committee on Wednesday over allegations involving online gambling and money laundering.

data.title: 'Gambler' Hudson ready to roll the dice once again
data.description: Thailand coach Anthony Hudson, pressed over his rotation policy, says he would make the same gamble again as his men face hosts Indonesia in tonight's inaugural Fifa Asean Cup final.
